name: circling-elements
title: Circling Elements
description: Small square images spaced evenly on an invisible ring orbit a blank middle at a steady speed; hovering the group freezes the motion and each tile enlarges.
use: A portfolio or gallery wants a playful, always-moving arrangement of thumbnails around a focal blank space.
avoid: Many images or precise browsing: the constant orbit and fixed radius make individual tiles awkward to target.
a11y: The continuous orbit ignores prefers-reduced-motion, and the tiles are plain images with no controls. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Six small square photos of a pug, blossom, dune, flower, snowy peak and a dark figure float in a loose circle on a black stage. Their spacing is even, the middle is empty, and there are no frames or labels around them.
behaves: The set turns continuously around the centre at a constant rate. Resting the pointer anywhere on the group stops the orbit, and the hovered photo grows slightly; leaving resumes the spin.
customise: Children are the orbiting items; radius, duration, easing, direction, pause-on-hover and class names are props, so each tile's size and hover style live in its own markup.
weight: light: Six small images each run one CSS keyframe; no JavaScript runs per frame.
